picks.reasoning: Chovy is the best mid laner on the planet, and Ruler is waiting behind him. Gen.G has the stronger players in nearly every lane, and that wins a single game. IG have Rookie, sure, but one star doesn't beat a whole lineup of them, and the LCK side carries the bigger gap here. I'm not buying any hype around an IG upset.

Early tempo is everything, and GEN's jungle-mid duo can grab first objectives, flip the map and snowball it from there. Chovy keeps lane priority, so the jungler gets to pick the first dragon and Herald fights. IG only competes if Rookie wins lane and Naafiri finds early picks, but the big region gap pushes me firmly to GEN.

Draft is where this one gets decided, and GEN walk in with the deeper book: Chovy on Ryze or Syndra, a jungle and support pairing that knows exactly how to build around him, and plenty of comfort picks to fall back on if Fearless takes the first options away. IG have Rookie and some real fight in them, but GEN's mid-jungle priority should shape the draft, and in a Bo1 Chovy's control of the tempo is the difference.

Numbers over stories, and this one isn't close: GEN have lost just 10 series all year while IG have lost 25, and Chovy's steady hand in a best of 1 is exactly what you want. IG's Rookie can absolutely pop off, and that LCK 2-4 against the LPL keeps me from going higher, but GEN's control is the call.
picks.thinking: GEN's the pick here — 37-10 overall against IG's 18-25 is a big gap, and even with that LCK-vs-LPL regional wrinkle in mind, I'd put GEN around 76% favorites. Keeping the numbers tight and the tone confident without just reciting the report back.

picks.reasoning: What I see in this Gen.G room is a group that's been through the fire and found each other: they've pulled games back from the brink, and a team that stays calm when things go sideways is a joy to watch. IG has real spark and Rookie can light up any stage, but the feeling around them is more up-and-down, and in a one-game Swiss showdown I trust the steadier, tighter locker room.
